name: skylark_add_known_traveler_number
intent: Add a known traveler number to a SkyLark trip
description: Opens My Trips in SkyLark, opens the trip for the requested city, enters the user's known traveler number from memory into the Known traveler number field, and saves it.
patterns: Add my known traveler number to my trip
Add my known traveler number to my city trip
Put my known traveler number on my flight
Save my known traveler number to my trip

inputs.name: trip_city
inputs.description: City of the trip to update

inputs.name: user_known_traveler_number
inputs.description: User's known traveler number to add to the trip

steps.intent: Open My Trips to find a trip
Open the trip to {{trip_city}} from the list
Type {{user_known_traveler_number}} into the Known traveler number field
